translations.web: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
translations.bsb: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
translations.kjv: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall
translations.asv: Thine arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under thee; They are in the heart of the king's enemies.
